source.commit_scope: Application and KI fixes; release packaging is identified by release_tag.

changes.summary: All 127 KIs carry Windows installation experience; 23 carry platform-specific recipes. Setup agents read the current platform's notes and canonical executable paths.
changes.user_action: Retry affected setup tasks. macOS and Linux recipes are kept separate; KI updates still use main.

changes.summary: Repair portable toolchain discovery, dependency command paths, pacman hook PATH, timeout process-tree cleanup and bounded output-pipe draining.
changes.user_action: Resume installation from the existing project. No step-count limit is introduced.

changes.summary: FSM2 passed the official Alptal example with 5,832 output rows; MARRMoT passed a real Octave 10-day synthetic model run. These are smoke tests, not scientific calibration certification.
changes.user_action: Supply project-specific input data and observations before calibration.

changes.summary: Refresh the Python 3.11 x64 installer and portable bundle, include Windows executable version resources, exclude scratch KI directories, and check the actual installed executable outside the checkout.
changes.user_action: Use the Setup executable. Portable users must extract the whole archive and keep _internal next to GeoForge Desktop.exe.

platform_notes.windows: Windows x64 only. Python is included; AI providers and scientific models are configured or installed separately. Browser frontend and tray exit are retained.
platform_notes.macos: This release does not replace the macOS application assets.
platform_notes.linux: This release does not replace the Linux application assets.

validation.source_regression_tests: passed with PYTHONUTF8=1: 343 app tests and 255 shared-library tests. Exact commands and final results are in the evidence asset.
validation.windows_frozen_smoke: passed: Python 3.11 DLL, 127 KIs and Windows notes, 23 platform recipes, nine HTTP routes, full harness, Flow, calibration dependency imports and main KI update source
validation.windows_installer_smoke: passed: silent install, actual installed-executable runtime checks and silent uninstall; both installer exit codes were 0

agent_update_protocol: Read release-manifest.json before changing an installation.
Compare product version, source.code_commit and source.release_tag for application changes.
Compare ki_library.source_commit and windows_overlay_commit for bundled KI changes.
Preserve user settings, API keys, proxy choices, projects, data and recorded model installation paths.
Verify the downloaded Windows asset against SHA256SUMS-Windows.txt.
Report the applied change IDs and any migration or retry action to the user.

installation_test_snapshot.scope: Installation outcomes, not certification that all scientific workflows or calibrations pass.
